page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: erat communis, sed hoc tantum effici, ut
naturae, cui perse non repugnabat esse
in pluribus per multiplicationem indivi-
duorum, jam repugnet ista multiplicatio.
XII. Vnitas universalis fit peractionem
intellectus absolutam, quae naturas rerum
abstrahit à differentiis individuantibus: sed
non absque praevia comparatione: non po-
test enim fieri, ut mens nostra concipiat
id, in quo individua conveniunt, relictis
propriis eorum differentiis, nisi prius ea in-
ter se comparet; nam absque compara-
tione non apparet, in quo conveniant, & in
quo differant.
XIII. Ad Unitatem universalem revo-
cari potest unitas eorum, quae dicuntur
καθ' ἑνός[?], vulgo, sed perperam, Analoga
attributionis; nec tamen omnia, sed ea
solum, quae pluribus attribuuntur deno-
minatione interna, veluti cum Ens dicitur
de substantia & accidente: Analoga pro-
portionis, veluti cum radix in plantis, &
id, quo animalia cibum admittunt, com-
muni vocabulo os dicitur: aut Analoga
attributionis externae, veluti cum animal
dicitur sanum denominatione interna; u-
rina, cibus, exercitium, &c. denominatione
externa, potius homonyma vocabula sunt,
quam Universalia, ideoque Unitatem uni-
versalem non habent.

page.notes:
The Greek phrase at the end of the first sentence of XIII is set in a small, worn type; the reading καθ' ἑνός is my best reading and is marked [?]. The signature at the foot is faint and may be D 3 or D 5; marked [?]. The faint text in the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and was left out. The printed "XII." and "XIII." are numbered paragraphs, so they are

, not headings.
